data.summary: SegmentedPills (scrolling pills with selected semantics), fractional RatingStars, single top Toast with tones; EcoIcons reads Phosphor fonts through const IconData because phosphor_flutter 2.1 does not compile on Flutter 3.47.
findings: Never import package:phosphor_flutter: its IconData subclass breaks compilation on Flutter 3.47; use EcoIcons (lib/design/tokens/eco_icons.dart) and add code points from the package's phosphor_icons_light.dart.
